messages:
ana: Quick design check on the evals scorecard legend + compact diff accessibility. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE (frame 60) :mag:
kevin: Short list: 1) change "No judgement yet" -> "Not scored" 2) compact diff labels need better contrast or larger weight 3) add SR announcement for view toggles.
maria: +1. For compact labels let's try 13px 600 first, then color if still failing.
tom: A11y: when toggling compact/annotated, fire a polite aria-live status like "Switched to compact view, annotations hidden". Also ensure keyboard toggle (v) updates SR.
eva-bot: Visual scan: compact purple label at 13px 600 still borderline in light mode. Recommend color token #072146.
kevin: Let's adopt #072146. Also change the persistent toggle text to "View: Annotated (v)" with aria-pressed state.
maria: Microcopy: change bulk-select from "Select all in view" -> "Select all visible examples (approx.)" and show exact count in tooltip.
tom: For toast undo, use role=alert and set focus restoration to the table header after undo. Add ctrl+z while toast is visible.
ana: Great. I'll update figma and push copy PR with these changes. Please thumbs if agreed. :thumbsup:
kevin: :thumbsup:
maria: :thumbsup:
tom: :thumbsup:
ana: closing after PR link.
